title: Draw a Diagram
text:
Draw a rectangle with river on one side.

```
    River (no fence needed)
    ────────────────────
    |                  |
  x |                  | x
    |                  |
    ────────────────────
         y (fence)
```

title: Set Up Perimeter Equation
text: Fencing needed: $2x + y = 200$ (two perpendicular sides + one parallel side)\n\nSolve for $y$: $y = 200 - 2x$

title: Side Along River
text: The side along the river is:\n\n$y = 200 - 2x$ metres
